name: Live TV (IPTV)
description: Live TV from your own M3U playlist and XMLTV guide.
about: Live TV from your own M3U playlist and XMLTV guide: a channel list, a guide and an info banner, with the number buttons to tune, favourites and recent channels. It is a page next to Home, on the green button. It also gives the voice assistant and AI agents one tool, iptv (find a channel, what is on, the guide, favourites, check a stream, reload).
